heading: INT. FISHING BOAT, MOORED AT DOCK - DAY

units.text: INT. FISHING BOAT, MOORED AT DOCK - DAY
A deposition held in a wheelhouse.
A stenographer's machine on a tackle crate.
Gulls outside.
The boat creaks.
ATTORNEY RENATA OKAFOR-LINDGREN, forties, sharp suit, sea-legs unsteady, leans against a bulkhead.
Opposite, in a folding chair, sits CAPTAIN GWENDOLYN "GWEN" HARTIGAN, sixty, weathered, arms crossed.
State your name for the record.
units.name: RENATA

units.text: Gwendolyn Hartigan.
units.name: GWEN

units.text: And you were the captain on the night of the sixth.
units.name: RENATA

units.text: I'm captain every night.
units.name: GWEN

units.text: Renata slides a photograph across the crate.
Gwen doesn't look at it.
She was found in your hold.
units.name: RENATA

units.text: She was my deckhand.
units.name: GWEN

units.text: And she was alive when she boarded?
units.name: RENATA

units.text: She was alive when she came on. She was alive when she went below.
units.name: GWEN

units.text: Renata taps the photo.
Gwen's jaw tightens.
And when she came up?
units.name: RENATA

units.text: She didn't.
units.name: GWEN
